# golang — 2019 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 6 golang CVEs of 2019 are in `data/cve/vendors/golang/2019.jsonl`.

### CVE-2019-25072 — Uncontrolled resource consumption in github.com/tendermint/tendermint
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Due to support of Gzip compression in request bodies, as well as a lack of limiting response body sizes, a malicious server can cause a client to consume a significant amount of system resources, which may be used as a denial of service vector.

Affected:
- github.com/tendermint/tendermint / github.com/tendermint/tendermint/rpc/lib/client: affected 0 <0.31.1 (semver)

Credits: @guagualvcha

References:
- https://github.com/tendermint/tendermint/pull/3430
- https://github.com/tendermint/tendermint/commit/03085c2da23b179c4a51f59a03cb40aa4e85a613
- https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2020-0037

### CVE-2019-25073 — Path traversal in github.com/goadesign/goa
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory('Path Traversal')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

Improper path sanitization in github.com/goadesign/goa before v3.0.9, v2.0.10, or v1.4.3 allow remote attackers to read files outside of the intended directory.

Affected:
- github.com/goadesign/goa / github.com/goadesign/goa: affected 0 <1.4.3 (semver)
- goa.design/goa / goa.design/goa: affected 0 <1.4.3 (semver)
- goa.design/goa/v3 / goa.design/goa/v3: affected 0 <3.0.9 (semver)

Credits: @christi3k

References:
